title: POST /api/integration/ha-url (body)
description: The integration reports Home Assistant's external URL as HA itself answers it: get_url without internal URLs, i.e. HA's configured external_url, else the Nabu Casa remote UI address (https://<instance>.ui.nabu.casa), else null. Sent at setup and whenever the value changes (core configuration update, cloud connection change, checked every 60 s for remote UI on/off); nothing is sent while it is unchanged. Integration token only (accepted only from the hub's own host). The hub accepts only HA's own external_url (read by the hub from the Supervisor) or a Nabu Casa remote UI address; anything else is answered 422 url_not_allowed (ha-url.error.json), so the integration token cannot redirect the devices' HA tokens to another host. The accepted value becomes ha_url_detected; unless the admin set another external URL in the hub (GET/PUT /api/settings/ha-urls, the hub value wins), it is the URL devices with remote access get as client_config.ha_url. null clears the detection. The report also carries ha_instance_id; a change of only this value is reported as well.

external_url.description: scheme://host[:port][/path], no credentials, query or fragment; null = HA has no external address.

ha_instance_id.description: Home Assistant's instance ID (helpers.instance_id.async_get, also the uuid of HA's Bonjour TXT record). Sent with every report; optional for older integrations. The hub stores it and hands it to the devices as client_config.ha_instance_id (second proof of the home network).
